turns.user_utterance: How come my cash deposit is not showing up. This can't be right. There must be some mistake. Where did my cash go. You better not have lost it as I need this money asap.
turns.assistant_response: I’m sorry this is worrying—if your cash deposit hasn’t appeared, it’s usually related to the deposit not being credited yet. Can you tell me the date and approximate time you made the cash deposit, and whether it was via an in-branch machine or a cheque/cash deposit slip? Also, which currency and amount was deposited?
